text:
Situation: Dopamine hydrochloride has been on FDA's shortage list since 2017-11-06 and remains Current as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 108 months. Current inventory across three sites ranges from 9.3 to 13.9 days on hand. Corvale East holds 74 units (12.3 days), Corvale General holds two lots totaling 142 units (13.9 and 9.3 days respectively), and Corvale Lakeside holds 14 units (13.8 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA lists Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343), Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., and Baxter Healthcare with Current shortage status. Hospira's plant received OAI classifications on 2010-01-19, 2011-06-17, and 2011-08-04. HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst, Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC, and ProPharma Distribution are not on FDA's shortage list today, and their labels name no identifiable plant.

Our position: Inventory is critically low at all sites. The Hikma alternate manufacturer option was previously approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD on 2025-10-24 but remains on FDA's shortage list. Non-listed distributors lack supply chain transparency.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and qualify HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst for emergency purchase; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC for emergency purchase; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate and qualify ProPharma Distribution for emergency purchase; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Pharmacist to verify Hikma product suitability for current orders per 2025-10-24 approval; requires P&T Committee ratification.

Not recommended: Rely solely on existing Hospira, Hikma, or Baxter allocations given prolonged shortage status and opaque distributor sourcing.
